title: Large-Scale Social Graph Analytics Platform with PageRank & Community Detection
problem: Modern social networks, financial transaction webs, and logistics supply chains contain deep relationship networks that traditional relational database SQL joins cannot analyze efficiently at scale. Calculating graph centrality, identifying dense community clusters, and locating anomalous cycles require specialized graph storage layouts and iterative graph algorithms. This project implements a high-performance graph analytics engine in Python, DuckDB, NetworkX, and FastAPI. The platform ingests million-edge datasets into compressed sparse row (CSR) memory structures, executes multi-threaded PageRank and Louvain community detection algorithms, evaluates multi-hop subgraph paths, and serves analytical graph queries through a FastAPI backend.
use_cases: Social network influence scoring calculating user centrality across large follower graphs
Anti-money laundering financial intelligence detecting circular fund transfer rings
Supply chain dependency analysis identifying single-point-of-failure bottlenecks
hard_parts: Optimizing graph memory layout using Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) matrices to prevent RAM bloat on million-edge graphs
Parallelizing iterative PageRank matrix computations across multi-core CPUs with strict convergence bounds
Implementing modularity-optimizing Louvain community partitioning across densely connected subgraphs
Executing sub-15 millisecond K-hop neighborhood traversals without combinatorial path explosion
screener_signals: Modular Python codebase separating CSR graph loaders, parallel iterative algorithms, and FastAPI endpoints
Deterministic benchmark demonstrating PageRank convergence on 1,000,000 edges in under 4.5 seconds on local CPU
Anti-fake verification script generating a dynamic star-hub topology and asserting exact centrality rankings

components.name: Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) Graph Loader
components.purpose: Ingests raw edge lists from DuckDB and constructs memory-efficient CSR adjacency structures

components.name: Parallel PageRank Centrality Engine
components.purpose: Executes power-iteration PageRank across node matrices to measure influence and authority

components.name: Louvain Community Detection Partitioning
components.purpose: Partitions graph nodes into modular communities through iterative local modularity optimization

components.name: FastAPI Graph Analytics Gateway
components.purpose: Serves multi-hop neighborhood queries, community membership looks, and centrality rankings

architecture.data_flow: Raw CSV/Parquet edge lists load into DuckDB tables; the CSR Graph Loader extracts directed edge pairs into compressed index pointers and column arrays; the PageRank Centrality Engine executes iterative vector updates until the L1 norm delta falls below 1e-6; the Louvain Engine assigns nodes to community clusters maximizing modularity Q; client analytical queries enter FastAPI; the gateway performs multi-hop neighbor lookups in CSR arrays and returns structured graph JSON in under 15 milliseconds.
architecture.enforcement_mechanism: Matrix convergence tolerance thresholds guaranteeing mathematical accuracy; bounded search depths preventing recursive traversal loops.
